meta.description: Unified SafeGuide alert sources. All AU sources below were verified to resolve on 2026-07-17. The v2 config contained fabricated Twitter handles/orgs (@QldNexus, @SADHRC, @TasHarmRed, 'Drug Harm Reduction Collective', 'ACT Harm Reduction Alliance', 'aodservices.wa.gov.au') — ALL confirmed non-existent and removed. Ground truth: 4 jurisdictions have real standalone alert feeds (VIC, NSW, ACT, NT); QLD/SA/WA/TAS have NO verifiable standalone public drug-alert URL and are covered by the national aggregator 'The Know'.

the_know.name: The Know (National — QLD Health / NCCRED)
the_know.description: National drug-alert aggregator run by Queensland Health (Metro North MH-ADS) + NCCRED. Clean WordPress REST API (wp/v2/alerts_warnings) with per-alert drug/location/severity taxonomies. Set as the national BASELINE covering ALL states: it is currently the only working source of NSW alerts (NSW web-scraper still TODO) and the only channel for QLD/SA/WA/TAS when they issue. VPTS (VIC) and CanTEST (ACT) remain enabled as enrichment — they add pdf_url + fuller PDF summaries for their states. Overlap is handled by fetcher dedup; refine dedup key to (state_code, date_iso, primary substance) if VIC/ACT show duplicates.

victoria._enabled_note: Disabled in the UNIFIED feed because The Know already aggregates VIC with cleaner structured data — enabling both double-counts VIC (title-based dedup can't merge differently-worded versions of the same alert). Parser is tested/working and kept for future pdf_url enrichment (match VPTS PDFs onto The Know's VIC entries by date+substance). NOTE: the standalone VPTS GitHub Actions pipeline (infoveaea-arch/safeguide-alerts) is UNTOUCHED and still produces the production single-region alerts.json the current app reads.
victoria.name: Victorian Pill Testing Service (VPTS)
victoria.note: Runs as its own GitHub Actions pipeline (infoveaea-arch/safeguide-alerts, 2x/day). NOT launchd. The unified fetcher is additive and must not clobber that.
victoria.description: Daily drug notifications from Victoria's official pill-testing service.

nsw.name: NSW Health — Public Drug Warnings
nsw.description: NSW Health official public drug warnings (dated entries, each links to a detail page). NUAA and DanceWize NSW repost these as community secondary channels.

act._enabled_note: Disabled in the UNIFIED feed for the same reason as VIC — The Know aggregates CanTEST/ACT with cleaner data; enabling both double-counts ACT. Parser tested/working, kept for future pdf_url enrichment.
act.name: CanTEST Health & Drug Checking Service
act.parser_status: TODO (PDF notifications — structurally similar to VPTS; can likely reuse the vpts adapter shape)
act.description: ACT fixed-site drug-checking notifications (PDFs on web, through May 2026), operated by Directions Health Services. Strongest state-level source after VIC.

nt.name: NT Health — Health Alerts
nt.description: NT Health alerts hub — issues public drug warnings (e.g. nitazenes). Web pages under the health-alerts section.

_qld_sa_wa_tas.note: QLD, SA, WA, TAS have NO verified standalone public drug-alert URL (research 2026-07-17). QLD banned pill testing Sept 2025; CheQpoint sites closed. SA's SADEWS 'High Alert' URL fails DNS. WA's MHC Early Warning System publishes no public feed. TAS has no dedicated illicit-drug alert page. ALL FOUR are covered by 'the_know' above — do NOT invent per-state feeds for them.

scheduling.note: The Know is the canonical multi-region AU feed (all states, clean taxonomy, deduped by nature). VIC/ACT dedicated parsers are disabled here to avoid double-counting what The Know aggregates (see their _enabled_note). The standalone VPTS GitHub Actions pipeline is separate and untouched. NSW web-scraper is deprioritised since The Know already carries NSW. NT will appear via The Know when NT issues alerts.
